answer: The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. Every entry must show Stitchbound canvas linen embroiderer thread seal before the ledger opens, because a seal canvas linen embroiderers renew after embroidery workroom hearings. The karst is small, but the toll is £29 in fees and a 13-day delay before the stamp dries, and the toll is charged per name, not per farm. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. Every lantern is counted once. The atlas is on the docket.
